Exam Date & Time: 24-Jun-2022 (09:00 AM - 12:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  SECOND SEMESTER B.TECH. EXAMINATIONS (MIT BANGALORE) - JUNE/JULY 2022  
  SUBJECT : CIE_1052 - ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES  
  ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES [CIE-1052]  
Marks: 50                                                                           Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
1A)          How does overfishing relate to "tragedy of the commons"? Explain it with the global  
  fish catch graph.                                                                     (5)  
  
1B)             Write down the significance of the Kuznets curve.  
  (5)  
  
2A)             Describe the three ways that the ocean may be used to generate energy.  
  (5)  
  
2B)             Explain all the stages in a nitrogen cycle.  
  (5)  
  
3A)             "Ozone is helpful or harmful depending on where it is found in the earth's atmosphere"-  
  elaborate the statement.                                                                (5)  
  
3B)             Discuss the various sources of and remedies for marine pollution.  
  (5)  
  
4A)             Describe in detail how India achieved self-sufficiency in agriculture through the green  
  revolution.                                                                               (5)  
  
4B)             Discuss the five steps involved in environmental impact assessment (EIA).  
  (5)  
  
5A)             Briefly discuss the various steps involved in the disaster management cycle.  
  (5)  
  
5B)             Why have floods become an annual affair in the southern city of Chennai?  
  (5)  
  
  
-----End-----
